items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Leonard contacted me a few years later and asked me to do this album, 'The Tribute To Andy Razaff'.

ctx.x: Well now you see Leonard Feather, he had access to some of these, I guess to this little company Period Records and they weren't even doing pop music. I mean they were doing classical music. And it started when he got the Kirby Group together, you know, and they called up Flow Down Gently, "Sweet Rhythm" and Re-visited. And so then they published that album. I think that those albums were distributed through membership type of arrangement. They weren't on the market. And then Leonard contacted me a few years…
